info.title: Wolfari Plan / Activity
info.description: Demo 1 addendum v1.0 plus Dress code writes (API050-053). Read projections for Locations/Packing do not imply public writers; Plan.capabilities names the writers this server offers. scheduled_date is additive; old request hashes are preserved when omitted.

servers.description: Native development; local demo Gateway port is 13000

get.description: Active membership required; structural edits require Plan Editor, completion follows actor attribution. Writes check expected_plan_version and current permissions on replay. Omitted PATCH fields retain values; null clears. Trip interval is [start_at,end_at); scheduled_date is a Trip-timezone day intersecting that interval. Timed changes clear scheduled_date atomically, conflicting explicit modes fail. No multi-item time cascade. Web uses Bearer access plus Origin/CSRF convention from identity.openapi.yaml; never call internal RPC directly.

200.description: Persisted result; replay returns saved receipt

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; write outcome may be unknown

get.description: FR-PL03. Active membership reads; Plan Editor writes on a Trip that is not archived. Exactly one scope: TRIP (plan_date and activity_id null), DAY (plan_date is a Trip-timezone day intersecting [start_at,end_at)) or ACTIVITY (activity_id of the same Trip). Writes check expected_plan_version and current permissions; a changed write raises plan_version and export_revision once and emits PlanUpdated. Omitted PATCH fields retain values; null clears, and the merged scope must stay valid. New rows are MANUAL; editing keeps the stored source. Deleting an Activity deletes its ACTIVITY dress codes. Web uses Bearer access plus Origin/CSRF convention from identity.openapi.yaml.

200.description: Dress codes of the current Plan snapshot

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; write outcome may be unknown
